display.name: 总览
display.description: 一眼定位：每图按角色或节点聚合，最多 4 条线；发现异常后到对应看板查看明细。由生成器根据明细面板重建。

display.description: 后端原生 TTFT 的 P95，按 Prefill / Decode 分线。P50 / P99 与明细见「后端请求性能」。

display.name: 加速卡显存 · 单卡最大已用（GiB）
display.description: 每个节点显存已用最多的那张卡；灰线为单卡总量。逐卡明细见「加速卡资源」。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(max by(node) (((node_xpu_memused{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"} >= 0) and (time() - timestamp(node_xpu_memused{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(node_xpu_memused{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))) / 1024), "role", "Prefill", "node", "xpu-2"), "role", "Decode", "node", "xpu-1")

max(((node_xpu_memtotal{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"} >= 0) and (time() - timestamp(node_xpu_memtotal{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(node_xpu_memtotal{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",devid=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~".*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))) / 1024)

display.name: CPU 使用率（%）
display.description: 主机 CPU 忙碌比例，按节点分线。负载、I/O 等待与磁盘网络见「主机资源」。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace((100 * (1 - avg by(job,instance,node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",node=~".*",environment="xpu-pd",job="node-xpu",node=~".*"}[1m]) + ignoring(mode) rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="iowait",node=~".*",environment="xpu-pd",job="node-xpu",node=~".*"}[1m])))) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="node-xpu",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="node-xpu",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="node-xpu",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "xpu-2"), "role", "Decode", "node", "xpu-1")

display.name: 主机内存（GiB）
display.description: 主机已用内存与总量，按节点分线。

display.name: 异常采集目标数（个）
display.description: 本环境当前抓取失败的采集目标数；0 为正常，没有任何新鲜采集时留空。具体目标见「采集与监控健康」。

spec.query: count((up{environment="xpu-pd"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd"}) < 15)) == 0) or (count(up{environment="xpu-pd"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd"}) < 15)) * 0)
